many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    n=len(g)
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if g[r][c]]
    rs=[r for r,c,_ in cells]; cs=[c for r,c,_ in cells]
    b=max(cs)
    cyc=[g[rr][b] for rr in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    return [[cyc[min(i,j)%len(cyc)] for j in range(2*n)] for i in range(2*n)]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def solve(I):
    n=len(I); r0=min(p for p,r in enumerate(I) if any(r)); c0=min(q for r in I for q,v in enumerate(r) if v)
    r1=max(p for p,r in enumerate(I) if any(r)); c1=max(q for r in I for q,v in enumerate(r) if v)
    h=r1-r0+1
    g=[I[r0+t][c0+t] for t in range(h)]
    s=(r0+c0)%h
    N=2*n
    return [[g[(min(i,j)-s)%h] for j in range(N)] for i in range(N)]
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    m=solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    ok&=m; print(k,m)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def diag(I):
    n=len(I); nz=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if I[i][j]!=0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in nz]; cs=[p[1] for p in nz]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); h=r1-r0+1
    main=[I[r0+t][c0+t] for t in range(h)]
    anti=[I[r0+h-1-t][c0+t] for t in range(h)]
    # check whether output looks like staircase from main or anti
    return (r0,c0,h,main,anti)

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']
    r0,c0,h,main,anti=diag(I); n=len(O)
    f_main=lambda a,b: main[min(a,b)%h]
    f_anti=lambda a,b: anti[max(a,n-1-b)%h]
    print(name,'bbox',(r0,c0,h),'main-fit',all(O[a][b]==f_main(a,b) for a in range(n) for b in range(n)),
          'anti-fit',all(O[a][b]==f_anti(a,b) for a in range(n) for b in range(n)))

    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    O=G[name+' output']; I=G[name+' input']; n=len(O)
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if I[i][j]!=0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in nz]; cs=[p[1] for p in nz]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); h=r1-r0+1
    D=[I[r0+t][c0+t] for t in range(h)]
    fits=[]
    for fn,idx in [('max',lambda a,b:max(a,b)),'min',lambda a,b:min(a,b)],[('imax',lambda a,b:max(a,n-1-b)),('amin',lambda a,b:min(a,n-1-b))]:
        good=all(O[a][b]==D[idx(a,b)%h] for a in range(n) for b in range(n))
        if good: fits.append(fn)
    print(name,(r0,c0,h),'fits:',fits)

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    I=G[name+' input']; O=G[name+' output']; n=len(I)
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if I[i][j]!=0]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in nz); c0=min(p[1] for p in nz)
    r1=max(p[0] for p in nz); c1=max(p[1] for p in nz)
    hh=r1-r0+1
    D=[I[r0+t][c0+t] for t in range(hh)]
    print('==',name,'n',n,'frag',(r0,c0,r1,c1),'D',D,'out',len(O),'x',len(O[0]))
    found=[]
    for f in ['minij','maxij','minmr','maxmr','minam','maxam','minbm','maxbm']:
        fdict={'minij':lambda i,j:min(i,j),
               'maxij':lambda i,j:max(i,j),
               'minmr':lambda i,j:min(i,n-1-j),
               'maxmr':lambda i,j:max(i,n-1-j),
               'minam':lambda i,j:min(n-1-i,j),
               'maxam':lambda i,j:max(n-1-i,j),
               'minbm':lambda i,j:min(n-1-i,n-1-j),
               'maxbm':lambda i,j:max(n-1-i,n-1-j)}
        def mk(key,m='min'): return fdict[key]
        gu=fdict[f]
        for s in range(hh):
            if all(O[a][b]==D[(gu(a,b)+s)%hh] for a in range(len(O)) for b in range(len(O[0]))):
                found.append((f,s))
    print('  fits:',found[:4])

G=load()
def test_form(nameI,nameO,f):
    I=G[nameI]; O=G[nameO]; n=len(I)
    nz=[(i,j) for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if I[i][j]!=0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in nz); c0=min(c for r,c in nz); h=max(r for r,c in nz)-r0+1; w=max(c for r,c in nz)-c0+1
    Dv=[I[r0+t][c0+t] for t in range(h)]
    ok=True; bad=[]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            u=f(i,j,r0,c0,h,n,I,O)
            p=Dv[u%h]
            if O[i][j]!=p: ok=False; bad.append((i,j,Dv[u%h],O[i][j]))
    return ok,bad[:6]
for nm in ['min_i_j','min_n1']:
